{{ModBox}}
'''Vile Precision''' is a [[Corrupted Mod]] that decreases [[recoil|weapon recoil]] by -15% per rank and [[fire rate]] by -6% per rank of primary weapons for a maximum of -90% [[recoil|weapon recoil]] and -36% [[fire rate]] at Rank 5.

==Stats==

|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! [[recoil|Weapon Recoil]]
! [[Fire rate]]
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || -15% || -6% || 4
|-
| 1 || -30% || -12% || 5
|-
| 2 || -45% || -18% || 6
|-
| 3 || -60% || -24% || 7
|-
| 4 || -75% || -30% || 8
|-
| 5 || -90% || -36% || 9
|}

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*This mod can also be stacked with {{M|Stabilizer}} and {{M|Gun Glide}}, which will provide a combined recoil reduction of -170%. Any recoil reduction in excess of -100% will have no effect. 
*Due to the lower fire rate, the added recoil reduction may be redundant. Not recommended for weapons like the {{Weapon|Latron}}, for this reason.
*Can be used with high fire rate primaries, such as the {{Weapon|Grakata}}, to reduce fire rate for lower ammo consumption while also taming the weapon's recoil. Due to the lowered fire rate, however, equipping this mod will result in lowered DPS.
*On weapons without recoil, this mod will only reduce their fire rate.
*This mod at max rank does not affect the {{Weapon|Vectis}} or {{Weapon|Vectis Prime}}'s fire rate, though both still benefit from the recoil reduction.

'''Vicious Spread''' is a [[Corrupted Mod]] which increases the [[damage]] by +15% per rank, but also increases the [[Accuracy#Spread (Deviation_With Aim and Max Deviation)|spread]] of [[:Category:Shotgun|shotguns]] by +10% per rank, to a maximum of +90% and +60% at Rank 5, respectively.

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*Damage bonus stacks additively with similar mods, such as {{M|Point Blank}}.
*Spread increase is additive with bonuses that increase accuracy, such as {{M|Soft Hands}}, {{M|Narrow Barrel}}, and {{M|Tainted Shell}}.
**Additional spread modifiers are <u>not</u> affected by bonuses that increase accuracy.
***For example, a {{Weapon|Arca Plasmor}} with {{M|Vicious Spread}} and {{M|Tainted Shell}} will have a max deviation of {{Math|{{Tooltip|16|Arca Plasmor's Max Deviation}} {{mul}} (1 + {{M|Vicious Spread|60%}} - {{M|Tainted Shell|77%}}) + {{M|Vicious Spread|30}}|t=y|bf=y|round=0.1}} degrees.

==Tips==
*As Vicious Spread affects the angle of a shotgun's conical spread, players can compensate by simply closing in and firing the weapon at almost point blank range to ensure all shots hit the target.
*Not recommended to be combined with {{M|Galvanized Acceleration}}, as the spread will be bigger at the bonus effective range and thus will cause more shots to miss enemies at long range, unless combined with [[Punch Through]] mods if the intention is to make the shotgun good at large crowd control.

'''Vile Acceleration''' is a [[Corrupted Mods|Corrupted Mod]] for rifles that increases their [[fire rate]] by 15% per rank to 90% at rank 5 but decreases damage by -2.5% per rank to -15% at rank 5. The increase in fire rate is doubled for bows.

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*Can be combined with {{M|Speed Trigger}}, {{M|Spring-Loaded Chamber}}, {{M|Vigilante Fervor}} and {{M|Primed Shred}} to provide a '''330%''' ('''660%''' for Bows) increase in fire rate while aiming, otherwise '''255% '''('''510% '''for bows)
*The damage reduction is additive. For example, a weapon equipped with maxed {{M|Serration}} and Vile Acceleration would deal 250% of its base damage.
**Compared to only a maxed rank Serration, adding a Vile Acceleration represents a loss of only 5.6% damage.
*With a max ranked Serration (but without {{M|Heavy Caliber}}), this represents a DPS upgrade over Speed Trigger of about 12% on fully automatic weapons that can take full advantage of the fire rate increase. It does still lead to greater ammo consumption and more frequent reloads though, so keep that in mind when modding your weapon.

{{Top|Orokin|Orokin|Orokin|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons|Prime|Prime|Prime|}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Once thought destroyed, the newly uncovered Vectis Prime revives Tenno martial traditions.}} The '''Vectis Prime''' is the [[Prime]] version of the {{Weapon|Vectis}} sniper rifle, featuring higher base damage, [[fire rate]], and zoom, and a doubled magazine, but with a higher combo count requirement. It was released alongside {{WF|Ash Prime}} and [[Carrier Prime]]. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage. *Two zoom modes: **First zoom has 3.5x zoom distance and +40% headshot damage. **Second zoom has 6.0x zoom distance and +60% headshot damage. **Zoom is not cancelled during reload. *[[Stagger]]s most enemies with every hit. *Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} and {{Pol|Naramon}} polarities. *Good candidate for {{M|Charged Chamber}} and/or {{M|Primed Chamber}} due to its magazine size of two rounds, or one round with {{M|Depleted Reload}}. {{Advantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Fastest [[reload speed]] of all sniper rifles. *Good [[ammo]] economy. *Pinpoint [[accuracy]] while [[zoom]]ed in; shots will hit exactly on the reticle dot, perfect for [[Enemy Body Parts|headshots]]. *Innate 1 meter [[punch through]]. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from 400m to 600m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Tied with {{Weapon|Komorex}} for the largest shot combo requirement of all sniper rifles. *High [[recoil]], which may make it difficult to fire a follow-up shot, especially at higher zoom levels. }} {{WeaponComparison|Vectis}} **Higher [[zoom]] distance (3.5x/6x vs. 3x/4.5x) **Higher zoom headshot damage (40%/60% vs. 30%/50%) ==Acquisition== {{PrimeTable}} {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ===Vaultings=== *On [https://forums.warframe.com/topic/800105-last-chance-for-ash-vectis-and-carrier-primes/ May 24th, 2017], it was announced that Vectis Prime, alongside {{WF|Ash Prime}} and [[Carrier Prime]], would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on May 30th, 2017. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is. *On October 12th 2017, Vectis Prime was obtainable as a Twitch Drop reward with [[The Great Eidolon Hunt]] event. *On [https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1016139-new-free-prime-bundle-coming-soon/ October 16th, 2018], Vectis Prime, {{Weapon|Fang Prime}} and an exclusive [[Weapon_Cosmetics#Other_Exclusives|Sugatra]] were released as Twitch Prime benefits. *On [https://www.warframe.com/news/vauban-and-ash-prime-vault November 19, 2019], Vectis Prime was unvaulted as part of the Ash & Vauban Prime Vault; it re-entered the Prime Vault February 11, 2020. ==Notes== *Due to the fact that it has two rounds per magazine instead of the Vectis' single round, {{M|Charged Chamber}} and {{M|Primed Chamber}} are less effective without the use of manual reloading. **Manual reloading also cannot be optimally performed due to the recoil animation after the first shot, which prevents the performance of an immediate reload. This can be circumvented by using the {{M|Depleted Reload}} mod, which reduces the magazine size of the Vectis Prime to 1, and increases reload speed (note, this alone will not affect reload delay, only the actual animation after the delay). However, this will slightly drop the weapon's DPS, due to the reload delay; a cursed riven, without fire rate or reload, will, in isolation, decrease it more strongly. *The Vectis Prime's forced Stagger counts as a status proc for {{M|Galvanized Aptitude}}. *The Vectis Prime has superior zoom capabilities to the Vectis, having a 6x maximum magnification compared to the Vectis' 4.5, while still maintaining a 3.5x minimum zoom for mid-range shooting. *The Vectis Prime has the largest shot combo requirement of the sniper rifles, needing 5 shots to initiate the 1.5x damage multiplier. {| class="wikitable" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0" style="text-align:center;border:1px solid black;width:80%;font-size:12px;" |- ! scope="col" |Combo Counter Bonus Tier ! scope="col" |Total Base Damage Multiplier ! scope="col" |Minimum Consecutive Hits Required |- |1 || 1.5x || 5 |- |2 || 2.0x || 15 |- |3 || 2.5x || 45 |- |4 || 3.0x || 135 |- |5 || 3.5x || 405 |- |6 || 4.0x || 1215 |- |7 || 4.5x || 3675 |- |8 || 5.0x || 11025 |} ==Incarnon Genesis== {{Transclude|Vectis Incarnon Genesis#Acquisition}} {{Transclude|Vectis Incarnon Genesis#Incarnon Genesis}} ==Trivia== *[[wiktionary:vectis|Vectis]] is Latin for "Bar" or "Pole", referring to a locking bar (or bolt), a leveraging bar such as a Crowbar, or possibly referring to a carrying pole. Or that it's supposed to be a bolt action rifle *The Vectis Prime has a bipod, as opposed to the monopod on the normal Vectis. This might suggest that this rifle would be more precise and have less recoil because of the extra support from the bipod. It is purely cosmetic, however. ==Media== VectisPrimeCodex.png|Vectis Prime in Codex. Vectis prime scope.jpg|The Vectis Prime's unique scope. File:Vectis Prime 1.png|Vectis Prime, as shown in the arsenal File:Vectis Prime 2.png {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|8NEJq9cP53U|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|kJdZKBl_Aus|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|uK7tOu-Imzo|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|e5-Q82C_IbY|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|wn1wlYu4yUk|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|G4rQWLKYIwc|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 15 Ammo per Pick Up: *Vectis Prime {{ver|22.12}} *Mastery Rank increased from 3 to 14. *Damage increased from 325 to 350. *Critical chance increased from 25% to 30%. {{ver|22.0.6}} *Reduced the headshot damage of the Vectis series in Conclave. {{ver|Plains of Eidolon}} ;General Sniper Changes *Reticle sway removed from all zoom levels! *1 meter punch through added to all snipers without any to start with (snipers with innate punch through unchanged). *1 combo count removed at a time when duration runs out instead of all of them (decay vs. cooldown). *1 combo count removed on miss instead of all of them *Additional bullets from multishot will each count as their own hits and misses in the combo counter *Combo duration reduced to 2 seconds for all snipers apart from Lanka which is reduced to 6 *Damage fall off begins at 400 meters and ends at 600 meters with damage reduced to 50% past 600 meters. ;Specific Sniper Weapon Changes - Vectis Prime *Fire rate increased from 1.5 to 2.67. *First level zoom +15% Damage replaced with +35% Head Shot Damage. *First level zoom reduced from 4x to 3.5x. *Second level zoom 20% Damage replaced with +55% Head Shot Damage. *Second level zoom reduced from 10x to 6x. *Next round is chambered immediately after firing instead of waiting for fire rate to cycle. {{ver|16.11}} *Introduced. }} ==See also== *{{Weapon|Vectis}}, the original counterpart of this gun. *[[Prime]], the [[Orokin]] enhancement to a Warframe or weapon. {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Vectis Prime]] [[es:Vectis Prime]] [[fr:Vectis Prime]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Sniper Rifle]] [[Category:Prime]] [[Category:Puncture Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Update 16]] [[Category:Semi-Automatic]] [[uk:Вектис-прайм]]

The '''Veldt''' is a [[Tenno]] semi-automatic revolver rifle sporting high damage and accuracy, but has a fairly poor fire rate. It also possesses an adjustable [[zoom]] via [[Alternate Fire]] while aiming.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon primarily deals {{D|Slash}} damage.
*While aiming, [[Alternate Fire]] adjusts the [[zoom]], allowing players to deal with enemies at close and medium ranges.
*Innate {{Pol|Naramon}} polarity.
*Has uniform [[spread]] while hip-firing and while scoped, meaning that shots will not stray above or below the reticle.

{{Advantages|class=Rifle|trigger=Semi-Auto|}}
{{Disadvantages|class=Rifle|trigger=Semi-Auto|}}

==Acquisition==
The Veldt's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Tenno Lab|Tenno Lab]] in the [[dojo]].

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Notes==
*While aiming, players can increase or decrease the zoom using [[Alternate Fire]].
*The pitch of the shots changes on the last 4 rounds.
*Unlike most other weapons that have variable zoom modes, (usually auto to semi) the stats of the weapon stay the same, neither punishing nor enhancing the weapon. This means players can choose to have low or high zoom, without suffering any negative (or positive) stat changes in doing so.

==Tips==
*Considering the weapon's alternative fire mode, {{M|Eagle Eye}} can be used to emulate sniper-grade scope amplification, excluding the scope reticle UI.

==Trivia==
*A ''[[Wikipedia:Veld|Veldt]]'' is a thinly forested region typical to the southern part of Africa.
*The Veldt shares several similarities with old big game rifles, including the large and ornate trigger guard and hammer, and the full-length rifle "scope".
*The Veldt was an offshoot of the {{Weapon|Tenora}}'s design process, which itself came from the {{Weapon|Pandero}}'s design process.

'''Vile Discharge''' is a [[Weapon Augments#Weapon Augment Mods|Weapon Augment Mod]] for {{Weapon|Embolist}} that stores damage up to the listed amount, which can be discharged via [[Alternate Fire]] to throw an explosive sac.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! Max Damage
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || 5,000 || 2
|-
| 1 || 10,000 || 3
|-
| 2 || 15,000 || 4
|-
| 3 || 20,000 || 5
|-
| 4 || 25,000 || 6
|-

==Acquisition==

* '''Vile Discharge''' was originally acquired by reaching Rank 23 with [[Nightwave]] during Nora's Mix Volume 2.
** Beginning with [[Nightwave/Amir's Shockwave|Amir's Shockwave]], it was added to [[Nightwave/Offerings|Nightwave Cred Offerings]] for {{Nc|20}}.

* Could be purchased from [[Daughter]] during the October 2024 [[Nights of Naberus]] event for 50 {{Resource|Mother Token}}.

==Notes==
*Discharge damage is charged by Embolist's main attack, any [[DoT]]s inflicted by it. Discharge damage itself (including any forced procs) does '''not''' charge a new Discharge.
**Charge amount is normally 1:1 of <u>output</u> damage. For example, it ignores enemy health types, enemy armor, and debuff amps such as {{D|Viral}}, but is affected by player damage buffs such as {{WF|Garuda}}'s passive.
**Overkill damage does not count towards the charge.
**{{Arcane|Cascadia Empowered}} applies towards the charge.
**Discharge can be spammed as long as the primary fire DoTs keep charging it.
*Discharge projectile always deals 10 {{D|Impact}} on contact, which is affected by Damage, Element, and Faction mods, but not multishot.
*Discharge explosion is 100% {{D|Toxin}} regardless of modded damage types or damage used to charge the attack.
**The explosion is not directly affected by '''any''' mods except {{M|Fulmination}}
***[[Valence Formation]] is able to apply the status effects to the direct hit and explosion, but not the damage bonus. However, the proc will affect Lavos if he is within range unless he has Valence Block active.
**Explodes in a '''6''' meter radius with '''~80%''' falloff.
**Does '''not''' inflict [[Stagger|self-stagger]].
*Discharge has a base fire rate of '''~2.5''' that '''is''' affected by fire rate mods, meaning it cannot perform other actions for '''0.4''' seconds after firing.
*Discharge cannot be fired while Embolist is using its primary fire or if it's reloading.
*Discharge cannot deal [[critical|critical damage]] or [[Status Effect]]s, not even with flat bonuses or pathways like {{Weapon|Mutalist Quanta}} orb, but can proc {{D|Slash}} via {{A|Seeking Talons}} which counts its own ticks back toward the charge.
*Discharge ignores the [[Rift]].

== Known Bugs ==

* {{M|Galvanized Shot}} is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits.

==Tips==
*Similar to {{M|Nightwatch Napalm}}, this augment allows Embolist to remain with a source of toxin damage even if it chooses to mod away from it, allowing for combinations such as {{D|Viral}} + {{D|Toxin}}.
*{{D|Electricity|Electric}} and {{D|Gas}}' radial damage can quickly charge the discharge. Grouping can maximize the damage gain from Gas procs.
*It is recommended to release the discharged before letting it reach its damage cap, as additional damage will be wasted into the charge.
*In practice, Vile Discharge can almost '''double''' the total damage output of the Embolist if timed well. Spamming it too much will prevent primary-fire damage for charging it, but waiting too long can let the charge overflow and be wasted.
*Radial status damage and [[Punch Through]] are highly recommended, as letting one attack hit multiple enemies will effectively multidip that damage via the discharge back to each individual enemy.
**For example, if Punch Through allows for the beam to strike three enemies for 35 damage each, that charges 105 damage for the discharge. When fired, each enemy now takes 105 damage, thrice as much as they took individually, but still towards all three enemies.

{{Codex|A true masterpiece of Höllvanian engineering. Vesper 77's advanced laser sight highlights enemy Weak Points with precision. Aim to increase its Critical Damage Multiplier.}}{{For|the [[Orphix]] mission on [[Venus]] in [[Empyrean]]|Vesper Strait}}
The '''Vesper 77''' is a 1999 semi-automatic pistol with extreme [[accuracy]] and an included [[Silent|suppressor]]. [[Zoom|Aiming]] activates the laser sight to highlight [[Enemy Body Parts|weak points]] with increased [[critical multiplier]].

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage.
*[[Zoom|Aiming]] highlights [[Enemy Body Parts|weak points]] indicated by crosshairs and grants '''+40%''' [[Critical Damage]].
**The color of the targeting reticle that appears on enemy head/weakspots is dictated by the energy color of the weapon.
*Can use the Vesper 77-exclusive {{M|Leaded Gas}} mod.

{{Advantages|
*[[Silent]].}}
{{Disadvantages}}

{{Acquisition|Vesper 77's main blueprint is awarded from Tier 4 [[Höllvania Central Mall]] [[Bounty|Bounties]] as a rare drop, requiring the completion of [[The Hex (Quest)|The Hex]] to access. The Barrel, Receiver, and Handle are awarded from [[Höllvania]] [[Legacyte Harvest]] and [[Hell-Scrub]].

Alternatively Vesper 77's blueprints can be purchased from [[Amir]] of {{Faction|The Hex}} for {{sc|Standing}}; component blueprints for {{sc|5,000}} and the main blueprint for {{sc|15,000}}, all requiring '''Rank 3 - 2-For-1'''.}}
{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

== Trivia ==
*The Vesper 77 is based on the Polish [https://www.forgottenweapons.com/pt83-the-sneaky-silenced-version-of-polands-p83-pistol/ PT83], derived from the [[:wikipedia:FB_P-83_Wanad|P-83 Wanad]], or the Russian [[:wikipedia:PB (pistol)|PB]], that has a fixed suppressor for the barrel and is designed so that the slide will remain closed when firing, necessitating manual racking of the slide to eject the casing.
** Key deviations from the real-world design include a fully-reciprocating slide, an underbarrel mounting point for the laser sight, more modern materials, and a general increase in size so as to fit at the scale of Warframes.
*The Höllvanian text on the right reads "OoRNIhNg MAeH FAyeHEhR OoHEhN UhNLOhDOhD" (Warning may fire when unloaded) and ".45 KAhL" (.45 Cal). The text on the left side reads "PAhTUhNTEhD SehP 12 1966, NOhV 4 1968, PR 15 1976" (Patented Sep 12 1966, Nov 4 1968, Apr 15 1976), "EhN 17 0451" (N 17 0451), and "VEhSPEhR MAwDUhL 77" (Vesper Model 77).

==Acquisition==
'''Velox Conclusion''' was originally obtained by reaching Rank 25 with [[Nightwave]] during [[Nightwave/Nora's Mix: Time Tempests|Nora's Mix: Time Tempests]].

==Notes==
* Extra enemies hit through [[Punch Through]] contribute to the buff stacking.
* Extra bullets generated from [[Multishot]] contribute to the buff stacking.
* {{D|Blast}} status effect, {{D|Detonate}}, contributes to the buff stacking.
* Damage instances from {{Arcane|Cascadia Empowered}} and {{Arcane|Secondary Irradiate}} do '''not''' trigger the effect.
** {{D|Blast}} procs spread by Irradiate '''will''' trigger the effect upon detonating.
* {{Arcane|Secondary Cryogenic}} cold spread does '''not''' trigger the effect.
